units.zh: 陳書卷二十三
units.en: Book of Chen, Volume 23
units.literal: Book of Chen, Volume 23

units.zh: 列傳第十七
units.en: Biography 17
units.literal: Biography 17

units.zh: 沈君理 王瑒 陸繕
units.en: Shen Junli, Wang Yang, and Lu Shan
units.literal: Shen Junli, Wang Yang, Lu Shan

units.zh: 沈君理
units.en: Shen Junli
units.literal: Shen Junli

units.zh: 沈君理字仲倫，吳興人也。
units.en: Shen Junli, whose style name was Zhonglun, came from Wuxing.
units.literal: Shen Junli, styled Zhonglun, was a native of Wuxing.

units.zh: 祖僧畟，梁左民尚書。
units.en: His grandfather Sengji had served the Liang as director of the left bureau of the people.
units.literal: His grandfather Sengji served the Liang as Director of the Left Bureau of the People.

units.zh: 父巡，素與高祖相善，梁太清中為東陽太守。
units.en: His father Xun had long been on friendly terms with the Founder and, during the Liang Taiqing era, served as administrator of Dongyang.
units.literal: His father Xun had long been on good terms with the Founder; in the Taiqing era of the Liang he served as Administrator of Dongyang.

units.zh: 侯景平後，元帝徵為少府卿。
units.en: After Hou Jing was defeated, Emperor Yuan summoned him to serve as minister steward.
units.literal: After Hou Jing was pacified, Emperor Yuan summoned him as Minister Steward.

units.zh: 荊州陷，蕭詧署金紫光祿大夫。
units.en: When Jingzhou fell, Xiao Cha appointed him grand master of splendid happiness with golden seal and purple ribbon.
units.literal: When Jingzhou fell, Xiao Cha appointed him Grand Master of Splendid Happiness with Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon.

units.zh: 君理美風儀，博涉經史，有識鑒。
units.en: Junli possessed fine bearing and appearance, read widely in the classics and histories, and showed sound judgment.
units.literal: Junli had fine bearing and appearance, ranged widely through the classics and histories, and possessed discernment.

units.zh: 起家湘東王法曹參軍。
units.en: He began his career as legal affairs aide to the Prince of Xiangdong.
units.literal: He began his career as Legal Affairs Aide to the Prince of Xiangdong.

units.zh: 高祖鎮南徐州，巡遣君理自東陽謁于高祖，高祖器之，命尚會稽長公主，辟為府西曹掾。
units.en: When the Founder was posted to Southern Xuzhou, Xun sent Junli from Dongyang to call on him. The Founder took a liking to him, had him marry the elder princess of Kuaiji, and appointed him western bureau aide in his headquarters.
units.literal: When the Founder held Southern Xuzhou, Xun sent Junli from Dongyang to pay his respects to the Founder; the Founder valued him, had him marry the Elder Princess of Kuaiji, and recruited him as Western Bureau Aide in his headquarters.

units.zh: 稍遷中衛豫章王從事中郎，尋加明威將軍，兼尚書吏部侍郎。
units.en: He was gradually promoted to attendant gentleman under the Prince of Yuzhang in the central guard, and soon received the additional rank of general of illustrious prestige while serving concurrently as vice director in the Ministry of Personnel.
units.literal: He was gradually promoted to Attendant Gentleman of the Prince of Yuzhang in the Central Guard, and soon added the title General of Illustrious Prestige while concurrently serving as Vice Director of the Ministry of Personnel.

units.zh: 遷給事黃門侍郎，監吳郡。
units.en: He was transferred to gentleman attendant at the yellow gate and given supervisory duties over Wu commandery.
units.literal: He was transferred to Gentleman Attendant at the Yellow Gate and supervised Wu Commandery.

units.zh: 高祖受禪，拜駙馬都尉，封永安亭侯。
units.en: When the Founder accepted the abdication, Junli was appointed commandant of the stable for the imperial son-in-law and enfeoffed as marquis of Yong'an village.
units.literal: When the Founder received the abdication, Junli was appointed Commandant of the Stable for the Imperial Son-in-Law and enfeoffed as Marquis of Yong'an Village.

units.zh: 出為吳郡太守。
units.en: He was posted as administrator of Wu commandery.
units.literal: He was sent out as Administrator of Wu Commandery.

units.zh: 是時兵革未寧，百姓荒弊，軍國之用，咸資東境，君理招集士卒，脩治器械，民下悅附，深以幹理見稱。
units.en: Warfare had not yet ended and the people were impoverished; the costs of army and state all fell on the eastern territories. Junli recruited soldiers, repaired arms and equipment, and won the people's willing attachment, earning high praise for his administrative skill.
units.literal: At that time warfare had not yet subsided and the people were destitute; military and state expenses all depended on the eastern territories. Junli gathered troops, repaired weapons, and the populace gladly attached themselves to him; he was deeply praised for his administrative ability.

units.zh: 世祖嗣位，徵為侍中，遷守左民尚書，未拜，為明威將軍、丹陽尹。
units.en: When Emperor Wen succeeded, Junli was summoned as palace attendant and transferred to act as minister of the left bureau of the people. Before he took up the post, he was made general of bright prestige and intendant of Danyang.
units.literal: When Shizu succeeded to the throne, Junli was summoned as palace attendant, then transferred to act as minister of the left bureau of the people; before taking office, he was made general of bright prestige and intendant of Danyang.

units.zh: 天嘉三年，重授左民尚書，領步兵校尉，尋改前軍將軍。
units.en: In Tianjia year 3 he was again made minister of the left bureau of the people and concurrently commandant of infantry; soon his title was changed to general of the forward army.
units.literal: In Tianjia year 3, he was again appointed minister of the left bureau of the people and concurrently commandant of infantry; before long this was changed to general of the forward army.

units.zh: 四年，侯安都徙鎮江州，以本官監南徐州。
units.en: In year 4, when Hou Andu was moved to garrison Jiangzhou, Junli retained his office and supervised South Xuzhou.
units.literal: In year 4, when Hou Andu was transferred to garrison Jiangzhou, Junli, with his existing office, supervised South Xuzhou.

units.zh: 六年，出為仁威將軍、東陽太守。
units.en: In year 6 he was posted as general of humane prestige and administrator of Dongyang.
units.literal: In year 6, he was sent out as general of humane prestige and administrator of Dongyang.

units.zh: 天康元年，以父憂去職。
units.en: In Tiankang year 1 he left office to mourn his father.
units.literal: In Tiankang year 1, he left office because of mourning for his father.

units.zh: 君理因自請往荊州迎喪柩，朝議以在位重臣，難令出境，乃遣長兄君嚴往焉。
units.en: Junli asked to go to Jingzhou to receive the coffin, but the court judged that a senior serving minister could not easily be sent beyond the frontier, so his elder brother Junyan went instead.
units.literal: Junli then personally requested permission to go to Jingzhou to receive the coffin, but court discussion held that, as a weighty minister in office, it was difficult to let him leave the borders, so his elder brother Junyan was sent instead.

units.zh: 及還，將葬，詔贈巡侍中、領軍將軍，諡曰敬子。
units.en: When the coffin returned and burial was near, an edict posthumously honored Xun as palace attendant and general commanding the army, with the posthumous title Jingzi.
units.literal: When it returned and the burial was about to take place, an edict posthumously granted Xun the titles palace attendant and general commanding the army, with the posthumous title Jingzi.

units.zh: 其年起君理為信威將軍、左衛將軍。
units.en: That same year Junli was recalled from mourning as general of trustworthy prestige and general of the left guard.
units.literal: That year Junli was recalled from mourning as general of trustworthy prestige and general of the left guard.

units.zh: 又起為持節、都督東衡衡二州諸軍事、仁威將軍、東衡州刺史，領始興內史。
units.en: He was again recalled as bearer of the staff, commander of military affairs in East Heng and Heng provinces, general of humane prestige, and inspector of East Hengzhou, concurrently interior minister of Shixing.
units.literal: He was again recalled as bearer of the staff, commander of all military affairs in East Heng and Heng provinces, general of humane prestige, and inspector of East Hengzhou, concurrently interior minister of Shixing.

units.zh: 又起為明威將軍、中書令。
units.en: He was again recalled as general of bright prestige and director of the Secretariat.
units.literal: He was again recalled as general of bright prestige and director of the Secretariat.

units.zh: 前後奪情者三，並不就。
units.en: Three times he was ordered to cut short mourning, and each time he refused to take office.
units.literal: Three times in all he was ordered to set aside mourning, but he did not take up any of the posts.

units.zh: 太建元年，服闋，除太子詹事，行東宮事，遷吏部尚書。
units.en: In Taijian year 1, after mourning ended, he was made steward of the heir apparent with authority over Eastern Palace affairs, then transferred to minister of personnel.
units.literal: In Taijian year 1, when mourning ended, he was appointed steward of the heir apparent and put in charge of Eastern Palace affairs, then transferred to minister of personnel.

units.zh: 二年，高宗以君理女為皇太子妃，賜爵望蔡縣侯，邑五百戶。
units.en: In year 2, Emperor Xuan made Junli's daughter consort to the crown prince and granted Junli the title marquis of Wangcai county, with five hundred households.
units.literal: In year 2, Gaozong made Junli's daughter consort to the imperial heir apparent and granted Junli the title marquis of Wangcai county, with a fief of five hundred households.

units.zh: 四年，加侍中。
units.en: In year 4 he was additionally made palace attendant.
units.literal: In year 4, he was additionally made palace attendant.

units.zh: 五年，遷尚書右僕射，領吏部，侍中如故。
units.en: In year 5 he became right vice director of the Department of State Affairs and took charge of personnel, while retaining his post as palace attendant.
units.literal: In year 5, he was transferred to right vice director of the Department of State Affairs and put in charge of personnel; his post as palace attendant remained as before.

units.zh: 其年有疾，輿駕親臨視，九月卒，時年四十九。
units.en: That year he fell ill, and the emperor visited him in person. He died in the ninth month, at age forty-nine.
units.literal: That year he fell ill; the imperial carriage personally came to see him. He died in the ninth month, aged forty-nine.

units.zh: 詔贈侍中、太子少傅。
units.en: An edict posthumously honored him as palace attendant and junior mentor to the heir apparent.
units.literal: An edict posthumously granted him the titles palace attendant and junior mentor to the heir apparent.

units.zh: 喪事所須，隨由資給。
units.en: Funeral expenses were supplied as needed.
units.literal: Whatever was needed for the funeral was supplied as required.

units.zh: 重贈翊左將軍、開府儀同三司，侍中如故。
units.en: He was further posthumously honored as general assisting the left and grandee with the same ceremonial as the three excellencies with office established, while retaining palace attendant.
units.literal: He was further posthumously granted the titles general assisting the left and grandee with the same ceremonial as the three excellencies with office established; palace attendant remained as before.

units.zh: 諡曰貞憲。
units.en: His posthumous title was Zhenxian.
units.literal: His posthumous title was Zhenxian.

units.zh: 君理子遵儉早卒，以弟君高子遵禮為嗣。
units.en: Junli's son Zunjian died young, so Zunli, son of his younger brother Jungao, was made heir.
units.literal: Junli's son Zunjian died early, so his younger brother Jungao's son Zunli was made heir.

units.zh: 君理第五弟叔邁，亦方正有幹局，仕梁為尚書金部郎。
units.en: Junli's fifth younger brother Shumai was also upright and capable in administration; under Liang he served as gentleman of the Gold Bureau in the Department of State Affairs.
units.literal: Junli's fifth younger brother Shumai was also upright and had administrative capacity; under Liang he served as gentleman of the Gold Bureau of the Department of State Affairs.

units.zh: 永定中，累遷中書侍郎。
units.en: During Yongding he rose through repeated promotions to gentleman of the secretariat.
units.literal: During Yongding he was repeatedly promoted to Gentleman of the Secretariat.

units.zh: 天嘉中，歷太僕、廷尉，出為鎮東始興王長史、會稽郡丞，行東揚州事。
units.en: During Tianjia he served in turn as minister of the imperial stud and minister of justice, then was posted as chief clerk to the Prince of Shixing, eastern pacifier, and as commandery assistant of Kuaiji, with authority over Eastern Yangzhou.
units.literal: During Tianjia he served successively as Minister of the Imperial Stud and Minister of Justice, then was sent out as Chief Clerk to the Prince of Shixing, Eastern Pacifier, and Commandery Assistant of Kuaiji, acting in the affairs of Eastern Yangzhou.

units.zh: 光大元年，除尚書吏部郎。
units.en: In the first year of Guangda he was appointed director of the personnel bureau in the Department of State Affairs.
units.literal: In the first year of Guangda he was appointed Director of the Personnel Bureau in the Department of State Affairs.

units.zh: 太建元年，遷為通直散騎常侍，侍東宮。
units.en: In the first year of Taijian he was transferred to attendant-in-ordinary of regular attendance of the scattered cavalry and attended the eastern palace.
units.literal: In the first year of Taijian he was transferred to Attendant-in-Ordinary of Regular Attendance of the Scattered Cavalry and attended the Eastern Palace.

units.zh: 二年卒，時年五十二。
units.en: In the second year he died, at the age of fifty-two.
units.literal: In the second year he died, aged fifty-two.

units.zh: 贈散騎常侍。
units.en: He was posthumously honored as attendant-in-ordinary of the scattered cavalry.
units.literal: He was posthumously granted the title Attendant-in-Ordinary of the Scattered Cavalry.

units.zh: 君理第六弟君高，字季高，少知名，性剛直，有吏能。
units.en: Junli's sixth younger brother Jungao, styled Jigao, was known from youth. He was firm and upright, with talent for administration.
units.literal: Junli's sixth younger brother Jungao, styled Jigao, was known from youth; his nature was firm and upright, and he had ability as an administrator.

units.zh: 以家門外戚，早居清顯，歷太子舍人、洗馬、中舍人、高宗司空府從事中郎、廷尉卿。
units.en: Because his family were imperial in-laws, he early held prestigious clean posts: secretary to the heir apparent, groom, inner secretary, attendant gentleman in Emperor Xuan's minister of works office, and minister of justice.
units.literal: Because his family were imperial relatives by marriage, he early held pure and prominent posts, serving successively as secretary to the heir apparent, groom, inner secretary, attendant gentleman in Gaozong's minister of works office, and minister of justice.

units.zh: 太建元年，東境大水，百姓飢弊，乃以君高為貞威將軍、吳令。
units.en: In Taijian year 1, when floods devastated the east and the people were starving and worn out, Jungao was made general of steadfast prestige and magistrate of Wu.
units.literal: In Taijian year 1, floods struck the eastern territory and the people suffered hunger and exhaustion, so Jungao was made general of steadfast prestige and magistrate of Wu.

units.zh: 尋除太子中庶子、尚書吏部郎、衛尉卿。
units.en: Soon he was appointed junior tutor to the heir apparent, gentleman of the personnel bureau in the Department of State Affairs, and chamberlain for the palace garrison.
units.literal: Before long he was appointed junior tutor to the heir apparent, gentleman of the personnel bureau of the Department of State Affairs, and chamberlain for the palace garrison.

units.zh: 出為宣遠將軍、平南長沙王長史、南海太守，行廣州事。
units.en: He was posted as general proclaiming distance, chief clerk to the Prince of Changsha, pacifier of the south, and administrator of Nanhai, with authority over Guangzhou.
units.literal: He was sent out as general proclaiming distance, chief clerk to the Prince of Changsha, pacifier of the south, and administrator of Nanhai, with authority over Guangzhou affairs.

units.zh: 以女為王妃，固辭不行，復為衛尉卿。
units.en: Because his daughter was the prince's consort, he firmly declined and did not take the post, returning instead as chamberlain for the palace garrison.
units.literal: Because his daughter was the prince's consort, he firmly declined and did not go, and was again made chamberlain for the palace garrison.

units.zh: 八年，詔授持節、都督廣等十八州諸軍事、寧遠將軍、平越中郎將、廣州刺史。
units.en: In year 8 an edict made him bearer of the staff, commander of military affairs in Guang and eighteen other provinces, general pacifying distance, central gentleman general who pacifies Yue, and inspector of Guangzhou.
units.literal: In year 8, an edict appointed him bearer of the staff, commander of all military affairs in Guang and eighteen other provinces, general pacifying distance, central gentleman general who pacifies Yue, and inspector of Guangzhou.

units.zh: 嶺南俚、獠世相攻伐，君高本文吏，無武幹，推心撫御，甚得民和。
units.en: In Lingnan the Li and Lao peoples had fought one another for generations. Jungao was a civil official, not a soldier, but he governed with open sincerity and won the people's deep goodwill.
units.literal: The Li and Lao of Lingnan had attacked one another for generations; Jungao was fundamentally a civil official and had no military talent, but he treated them with sincerity and governed them gently, greatly winning the people's harmony.

units.zh: 十年，卒于官，時年四十七。
units.en: In year 10 he died in office, at the age of forty-seven.
units.literal: In year 10, he died in office, aged forty-seven.

units.zh: 贈散騎常侍，諡曰祁子。
units.en: He was posthumously honored as attendant-in-ordinary of the scattered cavalry, with the posthumous title Qizi.
units.literal: He was posthumously granted the title attendant-in-ordinary of the scattered cavalry, with the posthumous title Qizi.

units.zh: 王瑒字子璵，司空沖之第十二子也。
units.en: Wang Yang, whose style name was Ziyu, was the twelfth son of Wang Chongzhi, minister of works.
units.literal: Wang Yang, styled Ziyu, was the twelfth son of Chongzhi, minister of works.

units.zh: 沈靜有器局，美風儀，舉止醞藉。
units.en: He was calm and composed, with broad capacity, handsome bearing, and restrained, gracious manners.
units.literal: He was calm and composed, with breadth of capacity; his bearing was handsome and his movements restrained and gracious.

units.zh: 梁大同中，起家祕書郎，遷太子洗馬。
units.en: In the Liang Datong era he began as secretary gentleman and was transferred to groom to the heir apparent.
units.literal: During Liang's Datong era, he began his career as secretary gentleman and was transferred to groom to the heir apparent.

units.zh: 元帝承制，徵為中書侍郎，直殿省，仍掌相府管記。
units.en: When Emperor Yuan exercised provisional authority, he summoned Wang Yang as Secretariat attendant; Yang served in the palace offices and managed records for the chancellery.
units.literal: When Emperor Yuan acted under provisional authority, he summoned Wang Yang as Secretariat attendant; Yang served on duty in the palace offices and also managed records in the chancellery.

units.zh: 出為東宮內史，[2]遷太子中庶子。
units.en: He was posted as interior minister of the Eastern Palace [2] and then transferred to junior tutor to the heir apparent.
units.literal: He was sent out as interior minister of the Eastern Palace [2] and was transferred to junior tutor to the heir apparent.

units.zh: 丁所生母憂，歸于丹陽。
units.en: When his birth mother died, he returned to Danyang for mourning.
units.literal: He encountered mourning for his birth mother and returned to Danyang.

units.zh: 江陵陷，梁敬帝承制，除仁威將軍、尚書吏部郎中。
units.en: After Jiangling fell, Emperor Jing of Liang, acting under provisional authority, appointed him general of humane prestige and director in the personnel bureau of the Department of State Affairs.
units.literal: When Jiangling fell, Emperor Jing of Liang, acting under provisional authority, appointed him general of humane prestige and director in the personnel bureau of the Department of State Affairs.

units.zh: 貞陽侯僭位，以敬帝為太子，授瑒散騎常侍，侍東宮。
units.en: When the Marquis of Zhenyang usurped the throne and made Emperor Jing crown prince, Yang was appointed attendant-in-ordinary of the scattered cavalry and assigned to serve in the Eastern Palace.
units.literal: When the Marquis of Zhenyang usurped the throne and made Emperor Jing heir apparent, he appointed Yang attendant-in-ordinary of the scattered cavalry to serve in the Eastern Palace.

units.zh: 尋遷長（史）兼侍中。
units.en: Before long he was transferred to senior acting palace attendant.
units.literal: Before long he was transferred to senior acting palace attendant.

units.zh: 高祖入輔，以為司徒左長史。
units.en: When the Founder entered the capital as regent, Yang was appointed left chief clerk of the ministry of education.
units.literal: When the Founder entered the capital as regent, Yang was appointed Left Chief Clerk of the Ministry of Education.

units.zh: 永定元年，遷守五兵尚書。
units.en: In the first year of Yongding he was transferred to serve as acting minister of the five arms.
units.literal: In the first year of Yongding he was transferred to serve as Acting Minister of the Five Arms.

units.zh: 世祖嗣位，授散騎常侍，領太子庶子，侍東宮。
units.en: When Emperor Wen succeeded to the throne, Yang was granted the rank of attendant-in-ordinary of the scattered cavalry, appointed chief tutor to the heir apparent, and attended the eastern palace.
units.literal: When Emperor Wen succeeded to the throne, Yang was granted the title Attendant-in-Ordinary of the Scattered Cavalry and appointed Chief Tutor to the Heir Apparent, attending the Eastern Palace.

units.zh: 遷領左驍騎將軍、太子中庶子，常侍、侍中如故。
units.en: He was transferred to command the left valiant cavalry and appointed junior tutor to the heir apparent, while retaining his posts as attendant-in-ordinary and palace attendant.
units.literal: He was transferred to command the Left Valiant Cavalry and appointed Junior Tutor to the Heir Apparent; his posts as attendant-in-ordinary and palace attendant remained as before.

units.zh: 瑒為侍中六載，父沖嘗為瑒辭領中庶子，世祖顧謂沖曰：「所以久留瑒於承華，政欲使太子微有瑒風法耳。」
units.en: Yang had served as palace attendant for six years. His father Chong once asked that Yang be relieved of the concurrent post of junior tutor. Emperor Wen turned to Chong and said, 'The reason I have kept Yang at Chenghua so long is simply that I want the heir apparent to absorb even a little of Yang's bearing and standards.'
units.literal: Yang had served as Palace Attendant for six years; his father Chong once petitioned on Yang's behalf to resign the concurrent post of junior tutor; the Emperor Wen turned to Chong and said: 'The reason I have long kept Yang at Chenghua is simply that I wish the Heir Apparent to acquire even a little of Yang's manner and standards.'

units.zh: 廢帝嗣位，以侍中領左驍騎將軍。
units.en: When the deposed emperor succeeded to the throne, Yang served as palace attendant while commanding the left valiant cavalry.
units.literal: When the Deposed Emperor succeeded to the throne, Yang served as Palace Attendant while commanding the Left Valiant Cavalry.

units.zh: 光大元年，以父憂去職。
units.en: In the first year of Guangda he left office to observe mourning for his father.
units.literal: In the first year of Guangda he left office on account of his father's death.

units.zh: 高宗即位，太建元年，復除侍中，領左驍騎將軍。
units.en: When Emperor Xuan took the throne, in the first year of Taijian Yang was again appointed palace attendant and commander of the left valiant cavalry.
units.literal: When Emperor Xuan took the throne, in the first year of Taijian Yang was again appointed Palace Attendant and commanded the Left Valiant Cavalry.

units.zh: 遷度支尚書，領羽林監。
units.en: He was transferred to minister of revenue and appointed supervisor of the forest of feathers.
units.literal: He was transferred to Minister of Revenue and appointed Supervisor of the Forest of Feathers.

units.zh: 出為信威將軍、雲麾始興王長史，行州府事。
units.en: He was posted as general of trustworthy prestige and chief clerk to the Prince of Shixing, cloud banner, with authority over the prefecture and headquarters.
units.literal: He was sent out as General of Trustworthy Prestige and Chief Clerk to the Prince of Shixing, Cloud Banner, with authority over the prefecture and headquarters.

units.zh: 未行，遷中書令，尋加散騎常侍，除吏部尚書，常侍如故。
units.en: Before he could take up the post he was transferred to director of the secretariat; soon he was additionally granted attendant-in-ordinary of the scattered cavalry and appointed minister of personnel, while retaining his attendant rank.
units.literal: Before he departed he was transferred to Director of the Secretariat; soon he was additionally granted Attendant-in-Ordinary of the Scattered Cavalry and appointed Minister of Personnel, his attendant post remaining as before.

units.zh: 瑒性寬和，及居選職，務在清靜，謹守文案，無所抑揚。
units.en: Yang was mild and conciliatory by nature. In personnel selection he aimed at quiet correctness, kept strictly to the records, and made no arbitrary promotions or demotions.
units.literal: Yang was mild and conciliatory by nature; when he held office in personnel selection, he sought quiet correctness, carefully maintained the documents, and made no arbitrary promotions or demotions.

units.zh: 尋授尚書右僕射，未拜，加侍中，遷左僕射，參掌選事，侍中如故。
units.en: Before long he was appointed right vice director of the Department of State Affairs; before he could assume the post he was additionally made palace attendant and transferred to left vice director, with a share in personnel selection, while retaining his palace attendant rank.
units.literal: Before long he was granted the post of Right Vice Director of the Ministry of Works; before he could assume it he was additionally made Palace Attendant and transferred to Left Vice Director, participating in personnel selection; his post as palace attendant remained as before.

units.zh: 瑒兄弟三十餘人，居家篤睦，每歲時饋遺，遍及近親，敦誘諸弟，並稟其規訓。
units.en: Yang had more than thirty brothers. At home they lived in deep harmony; at each season they exchanged gifts that reached all their close kin. He earnestly guided his younger brothers, and all followed his rules and instruction.
units.literal: Yang had more than thirty brothers; at home they were deeply harmonious; every year at the seasons they exchanged gifts, extending to all close kin; he earnestly guided his younger brothers, and all received his rules and instruction.

units.zh: 太建
units.en: In the Taijian era
units.literal: Taijian

units.en: (six)
units.literal: (six)

units.zh: 〔八〕年卒，[3]時年五十四。
units.en: In the [eighth] year he died,[3] at the age of fifty-four.
units.literal: [eight]th year he died,[3] aged fifty-four.

units.zh: 贈侍中、特進、護軍將軍。
units.en: He was posthumously honored as palace attendant, special advance, and general who protects the army.
units.literal: He was posthumously granted the titles Palace Attendant, Special Advance, and General Who Protects the Army.

units.zh: 喪事隨所資給。
units.en: The funeral expenses were met from official funds as needed.
units.literal: The funeral was supplied according to what was required.

units.zh: 諡曰光子。
units.en: His posthumous title was Guangzi.
units.literal: His posthumous name was Guangzi.

units.zh: 瑒第十三弟瑜，字子珪，亦知名，美容儀，早歷清顯，年（五）〔三〕十，官至侍中。
units.en: Yang's thirteenth younger brother Yu, styled Zigui, was also well known. Handsome in bearing, he early held prestigious clean posts and by thirty had reached palace attendant.
units.literal: Yang's thirteenth younger brother Yu, styled Zigui, was also well known. He had handsome bearing, early passed through pure and prominent posts, and by age thirty reached the office of palace attendant.

units.zh: 永定元年，使於齊，以陳郡袁憲為副，齊以王琳之故，執而囚之。
units.en: In Yongding year 1 he was sent as envoy to Qi, with Yuan Xian of Chen commandery as deputy. Because of Wang Lin, Qi seized and imprisoned them.
units.literal: In Yongding year 1, he was sent as envoy to Qi, with Yuan Xian of Chen commandery as deputy; because of Wang Lin, Qi seized and imprisoned them.

units.zh: 齊文宣帝每行，載死囚以從，齊人呼曰「供御囚」，每有他怒，則召殺之，以快其意。
units.en: Whenever Emperor Wenxuan of Qi traveled, he took condemned prisoners with him; Qi people called them "prisoners for imperial use." Whenever angered by anything, he would summon and kill them to satisfy himself.
units.literal: Whenever Emperor Wenxuan of Qi traveled, he carried condemned prisoners along; the people of Qi called them "prisoners for imperial use." Whenever he had some other anger, he summoned and killed them to satisfy his mood.

units.zh: 瑜及憲並危殆者數矣，齊僕射楊遵彥憫其無辜，每救護之。
units.en: Yu and Xian were in mortal danger several times, but Yang Zunyan, vice director in Qi, pitied their innocence and repeatedly protected them.
units.literal: Yu and Xian were both in mortal danger several times, but the Qi vice director Yang Zunyan pitied their innocence and rescued and protected them each time.

units.zh: 天嘉二年還朝，詔復侍中，頃之卒，時年四十。
units.en: In Tianjia year 2 he returned to court, and an edict restored him as palace attendant. He died shortly afterward, at age forty.
units.literal: In Tianjia year 2, he returned to court; an edict restored him as palace attendant. Shortly afterward he died, aged forty.

units.zh: 贈本官，諡曰貞子。
units.en: He was posthumously honored with his former office and given the posthumous title Zhenzi.
units.literal: He was posthumously granted his former office, with the posthumous title Zhenzi.

units.zh: 陸繕字士繻，吳郡吳人也。
units.en: Lu Shan, whose style name was Shiru, came from Wu in Wu commandery.
units.literal: Lu Shan, styled Shiru, was a native of Wu in Wu commandery.

units.zh: 祖惠曉，齊太常卿。
units.en: His grandfather Huixiao had served Qi as minister of ceremonies.
units.literal: His grandfather Huixiao served Qi as minister of ceremonies.

units.zh: 父任，梁御史中丞。
units.en: His father Ren had served Liang as imperial censor-in-chief.
units.literal: His father Ren served Liang as imperial censor-in-chief.

units.zh: 繕幼有志尚，以雅正知名。
units.en: From youth Shan had high aims and was known for elegance and integrity.
units.literal: From youth Shan had ambition and principle, and he was known for elegance and uprightness.

units.zh: 起家梁宣惠武陵王法曹參軍。
units.en: He began his career as legal affairs aide to the Liang Prince Xuanhui of Wuling.
units.literal: He began his career as legal affairs aide to the Liang Prince Xuanhui of Wuling.

units.zh: 承聖中，授中書侍郎，掌東宮管記。
units.en: In the Chengsheng era he was appointed Secretariat attendant and put in charge of Eastern Palace records.
units.literal: During Chengsheng, he was appointed Secretariat attendant and managed records for the Eastern Palace.

units.zh: 江陵陷，繕微服遁還京師。
units.en: When Jiangling fell, Shan slipped away in plain clothes and returned to the capital.
units.literal: When Jiangling fell, Shan escaped in plain clothes and returned to the capital.

units.zh: 紹泰元年，除司徒右長史，御史中丞，以父任所終，固辭不就。
units.en: In Shaotai year 1 he was appointed right chief clerk to the minister of education and imperial censor-in-chief, but since his father Ren had died in that office, he firmly declined it.
units.literal: In Shaotai year 1, he was appointed right chief clerk to the minister of education and imperial censor-in-chief, but because his father Ren had died in that office, he firmly declined and did not take it up.

units.zh: 高祖引繕為司徒司馬，遷給事黃門侍郎、領步兵校尉、通直散騎常侍，兼侍中。
units.en: Gaozu brought Shan in as marshal to the minister of education, then transferred him to gentleman attendant at the yellow gate, concurrently commandant of infantry, attendant-in-ordinary of regular attendance of the scattered cavalry, and acting palace attendant.
units.literal: Gaozu brought Shan in as marshal to the minister of education, then transferred him to gentleman attendant at the yellow gate, concurrently commandant of infantry, attendant-in-ordinary of regular attendance of the scattered cavalry, and acting palace attendant.

units.zh: 永定元年，遷侍中。
units.en: In Yongding year 1 he was transferred to palace attendant.
units.literal: In Yongding year 1, he was transferred to palace attendant.

units.zh: 時留異擁割東陽，新安人向文政與異連結，因據本郡，朝廷以繕為貞威將軍、新安太守。
units.en: At the time Liu Yi controlled Dongyang as a separatist, and Xiang Wenzheng of Xin'an joined him and occupied his home commandery. The court made Shan general of steadfast prestige and administrator of Xin'an.
units.literal: At the time Liu Yi held and partitioned Dongyang, and Xiang Wenzheng of Xin'an allied with Yi and occupied his home commandery; the court made Shan general of steadfast prestige and administrator of Xin'an.

units.zh: 世祖嗣位，徵為太子中庶子，領步兵校尉，掌東宮管記。
units.en: When Emperor Wen succeeded to the throne, Shan was summoned as junior tutor to the heir apparent, concurrently commandant of footsoldiers, with charge of the eastern palace records.
units.literal: When Emperor Wen succeeded to the throne, Shan was summoned as Junior Tutor to the Heir Apparent, concurrently Commandant of Footsoldiers, and managed the Eastern Palace records.

units.zh: 繕儀表端麗，進退閑雅，世祖使太子諸王咸取則焉。
units.en: Shan had a handsome, dignified bearing and moved with graceful ease. Emperor Wen had the heir apparent and all the princes take him as their model.
units.literal: Shan had a handsome and dignified appearance and moved with graceful ease in advancing and withdrawing; the Emperor Wen had the Heir Apparent and all the princes take him as their model.

units.zh: 其趨步躡履，皆令習繕規矩。
units.en: Even their gait and the way they set down their feet were made to follow Shan's standards.
units.literal: Their gait in walking and treading in step were all made to follow Shan's standards.

units.zh: 除尚書吏部郎中，步兵如故，仍侍東宮。
units.en: He was appointed director in the personnel bureau of the Department of State Affairs; his post as commandant of footsoldiers remained unchanged, and he continued to attend the eastern palace.
units.literal: He was appointed Director in the Personnel Bureau of the Ministry of Works; his post as commandant of footsoldiers remained as before, and he still attended the Eastern Palace.

units.zh: 陳寶應平後，出為貞毅將軍、建安太守。
units.en: After Chen Baoying was defeated, he was posted as general of upright resolution and administrator of Jian'an.
units.literal: After Chen Baoying was pacified, he was sent out as General of Upright Resolution and Administrator of Jian'an.

units.zh: 秩滿，為散騎常侍、御史中丞，猶以父之所終，固辭，不許，乃權換廨宇徙居之。
units.en: When his term expired he was appointed attendant-in-ordinary of the scattered cavalry and imperial censor-in-chief. Because his father had died in that office, he firmly declined, but permission was refused; he therefore temporarily exchanged quarters and moved his residence.
units.literal: When his term expired he was appointed Attendant-in-Ordinary of the Scattered Cavalry and Imperial Censor-in-Chief; because it was where his father had died, he firmly declined, but was not permitted; he therefore temporarily exchanged offices and moved his residence.

units.zh: 太建初，遷度支尚書、侍中、太子詹事，行東宮事，領揚州大中正。
units.en: At the beginning of Taijian he was transferred to minister of revenue, palace attendant, and steward of the heir apparent's household, with authority over eastern palace affairs and leadership of the senior rectifier of Yangzhou.
units.literal: At the beginning of Taijian he was transferred to Minister of Revenue, Palace Attendant, and Steward of the Heir Apparent's Household, acting in Eastern Palace affairs and leading the Senior Rectifier of Yangzhou.

units.zh: 及太子親蒞庶政，解行事，加散騎常侍，改加侍中。
units.en: When the heir apparent personally took up ordinary administration, Shan was relieved of his acting duties; he was additionally granted attendant-in-ordinary of the scattered cavalry and then promoted to additional palace attendant.
units.literal: When the Heir Apparent personally attended to ordinary government, Shan was relieved of acting authority; he was additionally granted Attendant-in-Ordinary of the Scattered Cavalry and then changed to additional Palace Attendant.

units.zh: 遷尚書右僕射，尋遷左僕射，參掌選事，侍中如故。
units.en: He was transferred to right vice director of the Department of State Affairs and soon to left vice director, with a share in personnel selection, while retaining his palace attendant rank.
units.literal: He was transferred to Right Vice Director of the Ministry of Works; soon he was transferred to Left Vice Director, participating in personnel selection; his post as palace attendant remained as before.

units.zh: 更為尚書僕射，領前將軍。
units.en: He was again made vice director of the ministry of works and appointed forward general.
units.literal: He was again made Vice Director of the Ministry of Works and appointed Forward General.

units.zh: 重授左僕射，領揚州大中正，別敕令與徐陵等七人參議政事。
units.en: He was again appointed left vice director and senior rectifier of Yangzhou; by special edict he and seven others, including Xu Ling, were ordered to deliberate on state affairs.
units.literal: He was again granted the Left Vice Directorship and appointed Senior Rectifier of Yangzhou; by special edict he and seven others including Xu Ling were ordered to deliberate on state affairs.

units.zh: 十二年卒，時年六十三。
units.en: In the twelfth year he died, at the age of sixty-three.
units.literal: In the twelfth year he died, aged sixty-three.

units.zh: 贈侍中、特進、金紫光祿大夫，諡曰安子。
units.en: He was posthumously honored as palace attendant, special advance, and grand master of splendid happiness with golden seal and purple ribbon; his posthumous title was Anzi.
units.literal: He was posthumously granted the titles Palace Attendant, Special Advance, and Grand Master of Splendid Happiness with Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon; his posthumous name was Anzi.

units.zh: 太子以繕東宮舊臣，特賜祖奠。
units.en: Because Shan had long served the eastern palace, the heir apparent specially granted the ancestral offering at his funeral.
units.literal: Because Shan was an old minister of the Eastern Palace, the Heir Apparent specially granted the ancestral offering.

units.zh: 繕子辯惠，年數歲，詔引入殿內，辯惠應對進止有父風，高宗因賜名辯惠，字敬仁云。
units.en: Shan's son Bianhui was only a few years old when an edict summoned him into the palace. In his replies and bearing he showed his father's manner, and Emperor Xuan therefore bestowed the name Bianhui, with the style Jingren.
units.literal: Shan's son Bianhui was only a few years old when an edict summoned him into the palace hall; Bianhui's replies and bearing showed his father's manner; the Emperor Xuan therefore bestowed the name Bianhui, with the style Jingren.

units.zh: 繕兄子見賢，亦方雅，高宗為揚州牧，乃以為治中從事史，深被知遇。
units.en: Shan's nephew Jianxian was likewise upright and refined. When Emperor Xuan was governor of Yangzhou, he appointed him clerk for administration, and Jianxian enjoyed his deep favor.
units.literal: Shan's elder brother's son Jianxian was likewise upright and refined; when the Emperor Xuan was Governor of Yangzhou, he appointed him Clerk for Administration, and Jianxian was deeply favored.

units.zh: 歷給事黃門侍郎，長沙鄱陽二王長史，帶尋陽太守，少府卿。
units.en: He served in turn as gentleman attendant at the yellow gate, chief clerk to the princes of Changsha and Poyang, concurrently administrator of Xunyang, and minister steward.
units.literal: He served successively as Gentleman Attendant at the Yellow Gate, Chief Clerk to the Princes of Changsha and Poyang, concurrently Administrator of Xunyang, and Minister Steward.

units.zh: 太建十年卒，時年五十。
units.en: He died in the tenth year of Taijian, at the age of fifty.
units.literal: He died in the tenth year of Taijian, aged fifty.

units.zh: 贈廷尉卿，諡曰平子。
units.en: He was posthumously honored as minister of justice; his posthumous title was Pingzi.
units.literal: He was posthumously granted the title Minister of Justice; his posthumous name was Pingzi.

units.zh: 史臣曰：夫衣冠雅道，廊廟嘉猷，諒以操履敦脩，局宇詳正。
units.en: The historiographer remarks: The refined standards of dress and office and the worthy policies of the court surely rest on conduct earnestly cultivated and a bearing measured and correct.
units.literal: The historiographer says: As for the elegant way of caps and robes and the fine plans of the court, surely they depend on conduct earnestly cultivated and a bearing measured and correct.

units.zh: 經曰「容止可觀」，詩言「其儀罔忒」，彼三子者，其有斯風焉。
units.en: The Classic says, 'His bearing is fit to be observed'; the Odes say, 'His deportment is without flaw'—in these three men such a manner was to be found.
units.literal: The Classic says, 'His bearing is fit to be observed'; the Odes say, 'His deportment has no flaw'—these three men possessed such a manner.

units.zh: 異黨向文政據有新安，文季率精甲三百，輕往攻之。
units.en: Yi's man Xiang Wenzheng held Xin'an. Wenji took three hundred picked armored men and struck lightly.
units.literal: Yi's partisan Xiang Wenzheng held Xin'an; Wenji led three hundred picked armored men and went lightly to attack him.

units.zh: 文政遣其兄子瓚來拒，文季與戰，大破瓚軍，文政乃降。
units.en: Wenzheng sent his brother's son Zan to meet him. Wenji routed Zan's force and Wenzheng surrendered.
units.literal: Wenzheng sent his elder brother's son Zan to resist; Wenji fought him, broke Zan's army completely, and Wenzheng then surrendered.

units.zh: 云太建二年高宗以君理女為皇太子妃，亦訛。
units.en: says the High Ancestor made Junli's daughter crown prince's consort in Taijian year two—that too is wrong.
units.literal: says that in Taijian year two the High Ancestor made Junli's daughter crown prince's consort—this too is erroneous.

units.zh: 太建三年納為皇太子妃 按「太建三年」當依
units.en: On "taken as crown prince's consort in Taijian year three": Taijian year three should follow
units.literal: "In the third year of Taijian taken in as crown prince's consort"—note: on "third year of Taijian" one should follow

units.zh: 作「太建元年」。
units.en: which reads "first year of Taijian."
units.literal: which reads "first year of Taijian."

units.zh: 〈沈君理傳〉
units.en: 〈Biography of Shen Junli〉
units.literal: 〈Biography of Shen Junli〉

units.zh: 與黃門侍郎王瑜使齊，數年不遣，天嘉初乃還。
units.en: He went as envoy to Qi with Huangmen Gentleman Wang Yu. They were detained for several years and returned only at the beginning of Tianjia.
units.literal: He went as envoy to Qi with Huangmen Gentleman Wang Yu; for several years they were not sent back, and only at the beginning of Tianjia did they return.

units.zh: 甲子，侍中、中權將軍、開府儀同三司、特進、左光祿大夫王沖薨。
units.en: On jiazi day Wang Chong, palace attendant, central authority general, opener of the mansion equal to the three dukes, special grand master, and left grand master of the palace, died.
units.literal: On jiazi day Palace Attendant, Central Authority General, opener of the mansion equal to the three dukes, Special Grand Master, and Left Grand Master of the Palace Wang Chong died.
